description: How the Charge Engine folds a tenant's due charges into Sales Invoices. The behavior key is dispatched by a handler dict in code (like RE Management Model / RE Revenue Model); every behavior additionally sub-partitions by (customer, company, tax_template, due_date) so invoices stay tax-homogeneous.

fields.description: Engine key handled in code. separate = one Sales Invoice per charge; group_by_category = one per Charge Type kind; single = one invoice for all due charges of the tenant. Grouping always sub-partitions by (customer, company, tax_template, due_date).
